##### Project general facts

Azizi David by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower set on the bank of the creek, blending the waterfront heritage of the old city with modern sophistication. A slender tower rises above a wide, light-toned podium, giving the building a balanced silhouette, while an elegant wave-like metal screen defines the base and the tower above shows clean lines and spacious balconies with glass railings. The building rises from a ground floor and a four-level podium to fifteen residential floors and a roof.

The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, together with three- and four-bedroom penthouses with panoramic views over the creek and retail units at street level. Residents enjoy swimming pools, a modern gym and a cinema, while an indoor multipurpose hall, a children's play area, relaxation areas, cafes and restaurants add variety, complemented by a welcoming lobby, lifts, spacious parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials in a neutral palette and feature large floor-to-ceiling windows that create a sense of light and space, while private balconies frame views over the water and the skyline. Open layouts and premium finishes enhance comfort and style. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Creek metro station is close by. Dubai Festival City, IKEA and Dubai Healthcare City are a short drive away, Dubai International Airport and the Dubai World Trade Centre are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai Creek Harbour are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
